name: block-diagram
description: Evaluate and improve Block Diagram drawings — components and relationships where no formal notation applies
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a BASIC_U.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build a block diagram of a layered application: presentation, application, domain and data layers
Build a block diagram of a data pipeline from ingestion through transformation, storage and reporting
Build a block diagram grouping business capabilities into three domains
Build a block diagram of a service topology with a gateway, three services and a shared cache
